# Empty Playwright test group

Create a Playwright test group using the `test.describe()` API from `@playwright/test`.

Requirements:

- Import `test` using ES module syntax.
- Include exactly three test declarations inside the test group.
- Set the title of the group and the title of each test to an empty string.
- Use asynchronous callbacks for the tests.
- Leave each test callback body completely empty.

Return only the test group in a JavaScript code fence. Do not include explanations, comments, or any other content.
